I wanted to give this plain front yard a premium upgrade, so I grabbed my tools and got to work! Watching the real progress unfold in this timelapse is incredibly satisfying. Here is a step-by-step breakdown of how I built this modern rock garden: 1️⃣ First, I mapped out a smooth, curved border on the grass using white spray paint. 2️⃣ Next, I dug out the edge along the line and laid down a heavy-duty black weed barrier. 3️⃣ I installed a sleek stone border, block by block, to keep everything neat and contained. 4️⃣ Then came the best part—pouring and leveling tons of crisp white river rocks for that beautiful, high-contrast look. 5️⃣ Finally, I styled the space by placing a dark statement sphere, planting some architectural agaves, and adding solar pathway lights. Seeing the before and after of this build progress makes all the hard work totally worth it! DIY Raised Garden Bed with Flowers & Lights | Front Yard Curb Appeal Watch this incredible front yard transformation! 🌸 Built a raised garden bed with retaining wall blocks, planted evergreens and flowers, and added landscape lighting for nighttime curb appeal! This weekend project completely transformed my home's entrance and it looks absolutely stunning both day and night! Perfect for anyone wanting professional landscaping results on a DIY budget. ✨ 🛠️ MATERIALS: • Retaining wall blocks • Cap stones • Landscape fabric • Quality topsoil • Evergreen shrubs (boxwood) • Purple flowering plants • Black mulch • Solar landscape lights ⏱️ TIME: 1 day 💰 BUDGET: $250-400 🔧 SKILL LEVEL: Beginner 📋 STEPS: 1. Mark curved design in lawn 2. Excavate area 4-6 inches deep 3. Stack retaining wall blocks 4. Add cap stones on top 5. Install landscape fabric 6. Fill with quality topsoil 7. Plant evergreens and flowers 8. Top with black mulch 9. Add landscape lighting The curved design creates visual interest, the raised bed protects your foundation, and the nighttime lighting creates amazing curb appeal that will make your neighbors jealous! 🏡✨ 💬 Questions about plant selection or design?
